keep.reason: Question 14 sets up the two-case idea and explains why only the whole-number result gives a triad; the following two apply it.

corrections.old:
Let $h$ be the vertical height and $B$ the whole base, in centimetres. The right base segment equals $h$.
$$\begin{align*}h&=\sqrt{29^2-21^2}\\h&=20\\B&=21+20=41\\x&=\sqrt{20^2+41^2}\\x&\approx46.62\ \text{cm}\end{align*}$$
